title: Research and Development - KITCOEK
text:
RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT — KITCOEK

KIT's College of Engineering, Kolhapur has a strong research culture with 4 PhD research centres, sponsored projects, and active publication record.

PHD RESEARCH CENTRES
KITCOEK has 4 recognized PhD Research Centres:
1. Department of Civil Engineering
2. Department of Mechanical Engineering
3. Department of Computer Science and Engineering
4. Department of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering

Ph.D. Eligibility: M.Tech/M.E. with 55%+ marks. GATE/NET score preferred.
Admission through institutional entrance test or valid GATE/NET score.

SPONSORED PROJECTS
Faculty have received research funding from:
- AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education)
- NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development)
- SERB-DST (Science and Engineering Research Board — Dept. of Science & Technology)
- Department of Science and Technology (DST)
KITCOEK has secured substantial funding for innovation initiatives.

INDUSTRY AND ACADEMIC COLLABORATIONS
- Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC), Mumbai
- Mae Fah Luang University, Thailand
- Knorr-Bremse, Germany
- Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)
- IIT Bombay (Spoken Tutorial project)

PUBLICATION RECORD
- Faculty publish research papers in national and international journals including IEEE, Elsevier, Springer
- Paper publication details available on website: https://www.kitcoek.in/academics
- IPR (Intellectual Property Rights) details published yearly
- Students encouraged to publish in conferences and journals for honors/minor credits

INNOVATION INFRASTRUCTURE
- Mayura-AICTE Idea Lab: Prototyping, electronics, PCB design, 3D printing
- NIDHI i-TBI (Technology Business Incubator) — KITE: Supports 10+ student startups
- E-Cell: Entrepreneurship development programs, guest lectures from founders
- Smart India Hackathon (SIH) participation every year
